title: ACL
shortDescription: Managing the configuration of access control list (ACL) rules for buckets and objects
metaDescription: All available methods for working with access control lists (ACL) for VK Object Storage buckets and objects: set the ACL of a bucket (PutBucketACL) or object (PutObjectACL); get the ACL of a bucket (GetBucketACL) or object (GetObjectACL)
